Test Case Description: GPIO Register Write and Read Default Value Check - Verifies that all GPIO registers return correct default/reset values after reset.
Register Description: Determines the level gpio pin. Read returns the current value of the corresponding pin regardless of whether the pin is an input or an output
Test Methodology: Read each register after reset and compare with expected default value. Mask read data with 0xFFFFFFFE before comparison.
Test Steps: 1. Apply system reset. 2. Read register at addr_array[i]. 3. Mask read data with 0xFFFFFFFE. 4. Compare with default_value_array[i]. 5. If mismatch increment def_fail_cnt.
Expected Result: Read data (masked) matches default_value_array for each register.
Notes: Skips registers where skip_rst_array[i]==1 or read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000

Test Case Description: GPIO Register Write and Read - Pattern 0xFFFFFFFF - Writes 0xFFFFFFFF to all writable GPIO registers and reads back to verify.
Test Methodology: Write pattern to register (masked with write_mask_array). Read back and compare with expected value computed as (data_wr & read_mask & write_mask) | (~write_mask & read_mask & default_value).
Test Steps: 1. Write (0xFFFFFFFF & write_mask_array[i]) to addr_array[i]. 2. Read register. 3. Mask read data with read_mask_array[i]. 4. Compute expected value. 5. Compare.
Expected Result: Read value matches expected computed value.
Notes: Skips registers where skip_array[i]==1 or write_mask==0 or read_mask==0

Test Case Description: GPIO Level Select Interrupt Enable - Active High Level - Tests level-triggered interrupt generation on active high level for all 32 GPIO pins (8-39).
Register Description: GPIO Pin signal level on which interrupt should be generated. 1-generate interrupt on level 1
Test Methodology: Program GPIO in input mode with level interrupt enabled (bit 20=1 bit 19=1). Enable group interrupt. Force pin high. Wait for interrupt. Verify raw status and group status. Clear interrupt.
Preconditions: System reset applied; #define GPIO0 1; GIC IRQ 87 enabled
Test Steps: 1. Enable GIC IRQ 87. 2. Enable sysreg interrupt (MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1). 3. Write 0x00180000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) for input mode + level_sel=1. 4. Enable group interrupt via MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1. 5. Write 0xFFFFFFFF to SRAM (0xA0243FFC). 6. Wait for interrupt. 7. In ISR: verify raw status bit[1]=1 and group status bit[i]=1. 8. Clear interrupt by writing 0x00110000. 9. Verify interrupt cleared.
Expected Result: Interrupt fires for each GPIO pin on active high level. Raw status bit set. Group interrupt status bit set. Interrupt clears successfully. Sysreg status clears.
Pass/Fail Criteria: test_err == 0 after all 32 GPIO pins tested.
Notes: Tests both per-pin and group interrupt status registers

Test Case Description: GPIO Level Select Interrupt Enable - Active Low Level - Tests level-triggered interrupt generation on active low level for all 32 GPIO pins (8-39).
Test Methodology: Program GPIO in input mode with level interrupt enabled but level_sel=0 (bit 20=1 bit 19=0). Enable group interrupt. Force pin low. Wait for interrupt. Verify and clear.
Preconditions: System reset applied; #define GPIO0 1; GIC IRQ 87 enabled
Test Steps: 1. Write 0x00100000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) for input mode + level_sel=0. 2. Enable group interrupt via MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1. 3. Write ~(1<<i) to SRAM (0xA0243FFC). 4. Wait for interrupt. 5. In ISR: verify raw status and group status. 6. Clear interrupt. 7. Verify cleared.
Expected Result: Interrupt fires for each GPIO pin on active low level. Raw status bit set. Group interrupt status bit set. Interrupt clears successfully.
Pass/Fail Criteria: test_err == 0 after all 32 GPIO pins tested.
Notes: Complements the active-high test; verifies level_sel=0 functionality

Test Case Description: GPIO Group Interrupt Status Verification - Verifies MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1 register reflects correct per-pin interrupt status.
Register Description: gp0_intr1 Interrupt masked status for GPIO_8
Test Methodology: Read group interrupt status register inside ISR and verify the correct bit corresponding to the interrupted GPIO pin is set.
Preconditions: System reset applied; Interrupt triggered on specific GPIO pin
Test Steps: 1. Trigger interrupt on GPIO pin i. 2. In ISR read MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1. 3. Verify bit[i] is set. 4. Disable group interrupt. 5. Re-read and verify status is 0.
Expected Result: Group interrupt status register bit[i] matches the GPIO pin that triggered the interrupt.
Pass/Fail Criteria: Bit[i] set when interrupt active; register reads 0 after interrupt enable cleared.
Notes: Tested as part of level_sel_intr_en ISR flow

Test Case Description: GPIO Sysreg Interrupt Clear Verification - Verifies LSS sysreg interrupt raw status clear for GPIO0.
Register Description: Interrupt raw status and clear for gpio0_intr
Test Methodology: Write to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 with LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR to clear. Read back and verify cleared.
Preconditions: System reset applied; GPIO0 interrupt triggered and handled
Test Steps: 1. After GPIO interrupt handled write LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1. 2. Read MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1. 3. Verify (rdata & LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR) == 0.
Expected Result: Sysreg raw status bit for GPIO0 interrupt is cleared after write.
Pass/Fail Criteria: Status bit reads 0 after clear write.
Notes: Verifies end-to-end interrupt clear from GPIO through sysreg

Test Case Description: GPIO VRRW Register Skip Verification - Verifies that VRRW-type registers (offsets 0x80 0x94 0x98 0x9C 0xA0 0xA4 0xA8 0xAC 0xB0) are correctly skipped during write/read test.
Register Description: Interrupt raw status and clear for GPIO_8
Test Methodology: Confirm skip_array marks VRRW registers as skip=1 so they are not written during WR/RD test. Verify skip_rst_array marks them for reset skip as well.
Test Steps: 1. Check skip_array[32]=1 for VRRW register at offset 0x80. 2. Verify program.c skips writing to these addresses. 3. Confirm no false failures from VRRW registers.
Expected Result: VRRW registers are skipped and do not cause test failures.
Pass/Fail Criteria: No wr_fail_cnt or def_fail_cnt increments from VRRW registers.
Notes: VRRW registers: gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 gpio_io_ctrl_group1-4 gpio_dout_group1-4 gpio_din_group1-4
